neighbours.label: The first modifier word of a multi-word scientific measurement or imaging technique name (small angle X-ray scattering, functional MRI, positron emission tomography)
fire: The crystals were studied with wide angle X-ray diffraction at room temperature.
Brain activity was recorded with functional magnetic resonance imaging during the task.
Tumours were located by single photon emission computed tomography.
The film thickness was measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry and atomic force microscopy.
Particle sizes were confirmed using dynamic light scattering in water.
Surface chemistry was analysed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy after etching.
The protein structure was solved by nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy.
Cell death was quantified by indirect immunofluorescence staining of the sections.
quiet: The ramp meets the floor at a wide angle near the door.
Her role on the committee was mostly functional rather than creative.
Factory emission levels fell sharply after the new rules.
The thickness of the old paint layer surprised the builders.
Light from the window was scattered across the dusty table.
The chemistry teacher handed out the surface cleaning rota.
Her magnetic personality made her popular at the conference.
The staining on the shirt would not come out in the wash.

notes: Fire items put the modifier mid-sentence before a technique name; near misses use the same words outside any technique name.
